summary: st agents restart --fresh-session starts a new native session instead of continuing the last one; it is refused unless the seat has a handoff written or marked ready since its last turn, and the new session is given that handoff first. Without the flag a restart continues the last session as before

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes for existing claims. A restart request carries an optional fresh_session field, and the daemon appends one runtime.action.requested claim with action 'fresh-session' before it launches the replacement; a daemon without this change ignores both.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. runtime.action.requested gains the optional boolean field fresh_session.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: An older daemon given a --fresh-session request ignores the field and continues the last session, as a plain restart does. The new CLI flag is optional and the default is unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected interruption.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
